intervention_description: Poultry package with 16 improved breed chickens, feed, coop materials, and veterinary services; unconditional cash transfer of $200 to women in poor households

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Cash transfer of $200 provides direct consumption support
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Poultry package provides productive assets (16 chickens)
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: One-time training on poultry husbandry practices

outcomes.outcome_description: Probability of engaging in regular wage work
outcomes.literal_text: Figure 4 shows coefficients for wage work probability

outcomes.outcome_description: Probability of engaging in day labor
outcomes.literal_text: Figure 4 shows coefficients for casual wage work probability
Substantial positive effects on savings as reported by women

outcomes.outcome_description: Access to credit or bank accounts
outcomes.literal_text: Little evidence of enhanced access to credit or bank accounts
Probability of poultry ownership increases by about 40 percentage points to 94%

outcomes.outcome_description: Total number of poultry chickens owned
outcomes.literal_text: Number of poultry owned increases by about eight chickens

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of households reporting income from poultry sales
outcomes.literal_text: 64% of poultry package households reported income from poultry sales vs 36% in control arm
